artifact_observations.reasoning: The vertical bars on the right side of the corridor appear to warp and merge into the wall structure inconsistently. Some bars seem to terminate abruptly or blend into the background texture without clear mounting points.
The skin texture on the arms is overly smooth and plastic-like compared to the face. The fingers gripping the bar on the right lack distinct definition and appear slightly fused with the bar.
The perspective lines of the ceiling beams and upper walls are slightly inconsistent, creating a subtle sense of spatial warping in the background.

To audit the structural integrity of the human figure, specifically hand-bar interaction and arm anatomy, which are common failure points in AI generation.
To check for continuity errors in the vertical bars, ensuring they are distinct, parallel entities and not melting into each other or the walls.
To assess general image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global artifacts missed by specific auditors.

focus_areas: Parallelism and continuity of vertical bars
